key_facts: The company raised its full year revenue guidance and adjusted earnings per share guidance for the remainder of 2021.
The company reported a 18.6% increase in revenue for the third quarter and a 14.5% increase for the nine months ended September 30.
Same unit revenue for the third quarter grew by 8.3% compared with last year, and for the nine months, it grew by 7.3% compared with last year.
Total revenue in the Financial Services group grew by 20.4% in the third quarter and by 16% for the nine months.
Total revenue in the benefits and insurance group grew by 16.1% in the third quarter and by 12.4% for the nine months.
The company experienced a decline in margin on income before tax in the third quarter from 11.4% a year ago to 10.3% due to higher expenses.
On an adjusted basis, the company's margin on income before tax for the nine months improved by 120 basis points, reaching 15.2% compared with 14% a year ago.
The company closed five acquisition transactions that will contribute approximately $72 million of annualized revenue.
Through September 30, the company used $74.8 million for acquisition purposes, including earn-out payments on acquisitions closed in prior years.

Future earn-out payments are estimated at approximately $6.6 million for the balance of this year, $26.7 million in 2022, $19.3 million in 2023, $22.9 million in 2024, and approximately $6 million in 2025.
The company repurchased approximately 2.7 million shares through September 30, using $85 million, and an additional 258,000 shares through October 26.
The company expects a full year share count within a range of 53.5 million to 54 million shares.
Debt outstanding on the company's unsecured $400 million credit line was $190.2 million at September 30, with $201.6 million of unused capacity.
Leverage under the credit facility was 1.2 times adjusted EBITDA at September 30.
Adjusted EBITDA for the nine months this year was $153.5 million, up 21% from $126.9 million a year ago.
Capital spending through September 30 was $6.5 million, with $3.2 million spent in the third quarter.
The company expects full year spending to be between $8 million to $10 million.
Day sales outstanding on receivables was 88 days at September 30, reflecting improvements over the past 12 to 18 months.
Bad debt expense through September 30 this year was approximately 10 basis points of revenue compared with 41 basis points a year ago.
The company's effective tax rate for the nine months was approximately 24.5%.
The company expects a full year effective tax rate within a range of 24% to 24.5%.
The company expects total revenue growth in 2021 to be within a range of 12% to 15% over 2020.
Adjusted earnings-per-share growth is expected within a range of 20% to 24% over the $1.42 earnings per share recorded in 2020.
The company completed the acquisition of Shea Labagh Dobberstein, an accounting, tax, and advisory services firm based in San Francisco, Bay Area, in early September.
The acquisition of Shea Labagh Dobberstein adds valuable capacity and scale in the West Coast market and complements the company's existing geographic footprint.
